Tofugu: Learn to recognize all hiragana in a matter of hours

I was sick yesterday and decided to try learning some hiragana (i've never studied with anything but romaji before). I found this website around noon and was able to recognize all of them before bed. I spent about 11 hours from start to finish, but the vast majority of the time was spent watching TV shows during the recommended waiting periods between sessions. I'd say I probably spent 3-4 hours in actual study.

So if someone has a full day and wants to learn to read (not write) hiragana, I'd recommend it.

EDIT: I learned katakana in about 2 hours. I also just realized this is the same site as wanikani, the most recommended site for learning Kanji (though the kana is free, you have to pay for the kanji).

Same guide I learned hiragana from, I recommend it to any and all beginners who hasn't started learning yet. Just as WhiteTigerScream it only took me an afternoon to be able to read all hiragana. A great first step.

Feel like building a typical home built on the endstone expanse? You might like to try building in the Ground Zone (which /warp Endaxion will take you to directly!)

Feel like burrowing underground, or having a home that looks out on the tranquil darkness that is the Void? You might like to build in the Dark Zone, which is connected to the outer edges of the island by a network of tunnels!
